_about: Science words, each explained in one short sentence. Shown the first time a word appears.
radiation: Radiation is invisible energy that can hurt our bodies.
sol: A sol is one day on Mars, about 40 minutes longer than Earth's.
solarFlare: A solar flare is a sudden flash of energy from the Sun.
dustOpacity: Dust opacity means how much dust blocks the Sun.
oxygen: Oxygen is the part of air we need to breathe.
solarPanel: A solar panel turns sunlight into power.
signalDelay: Signal delay is the time a message takes to travel.
atmosphere: An atmosphere is the blanket of air around a planet.
cme: A CME is a giant cloud of the Sun's gas flying into space.
